purpose: Repeat Exp12/Exp13 GTE Q41 cold embedding conditions to assess timing variance.
cache_policy: embedding cache disabled by removing cache_db_path from temporary configs
scope: document embedding + vector DB build only; excludes search/acquisition/query encoding/retrieval/rerank/generation
leader_gpu_rerun_note: OMX worker-1 attempted a CPU-only rerun and aborted; the comparable reruns in this summary were executed by the leader in the GPU-enabled runtime.
interpretation: The same corpus/config can vary materially because the benchmark times model load, CUDA/PyTorch initialization, first-batch warmup, encoding, Python object conversion, CSV write, and config write together. The repeated GPU runs make the Exp12-vs-Exp13 30s gap plausible runtime variance rather than an input/config difference.
